meta.source: Mile High United Way Turkey Trot event archives + HAL Sports + Strava export
meta.policy: Official event distance/date/venue are canonical. Strava supplies exact activity evidence and fallback elapsed time until an individual official timing row is recovered. Repeated GPS geometry may recover a race hidden behind a generic activity name when the event date, venue, distance, and course all align.

adventures.name: Mile High United Way Turkey Trot
adventures.resultSource: HAL Sports 2021 event-results archive + Mile High United Way event identity
adventures.matchSource: Exact Thanksgiving Day date + 4.03-mile GPS recording + Washington Park start/finish + near-identical route geometry to the independently verified 2025 Mile High United Way Turkey Trot course
adventures.note: Recovered despite the generic Strava name. HAL Sports lists the Mile High United Way Turkey Trot at Washington Park on November 25, 2021, and contemporary event coverage identifies it as a four-mile run/walk. The personal GPS track starts and finishes within meters of the verified 2025 Turkey Trot track and follows essentially the same Washington Park course. No indexed individual timing row has been recovered, so 31:12 is retained only as the Strava elapsed-time fallback.

adventures.resultSource: Mile High United Way official 2023 Turkey Trot event archive
adventures.matchSource: Exact Thanksgiving Day date + official four-mile Washington Park event + source GPS contains the complete repeated Turkey Trot course after an approximately 1.60 km approach/warmup
adventures.note: The generic 8.186 km Strava activity includes approximately 1.60 km of approach/warmup before reaching the Turkey Trot start. The published route is intentionally cropped to the 566-point race-course segment: about 6.57 km / 4.08 miles, starting and finishing within meters of the 2021 and 2025 course and matching the repeated route throughout. The race-course segment spans 38:17 in the GPS source, but no indexed individual timing row has been recovered, so that value is route-context evidence rather than an official result.

adventures.name: Mile High United Way Turkey Trot
adventures.resultSource: Mile High United Way official 2025 Turkey Trot event archive
adventures.matchSource: Exact Thanksgiving Day date + Strava activity explicitly named Turkey Trot + 6.494 km recording + approximately 10:02 AM local start matching the organizer's 10:00 AM Wave 3 + Washington Park event identity
adventures.note: Mile High United Way identifies the Nov. 27, 2025 event as its 52nd annual Turkey Trot at Washington Park and describes the course as a 4-mile walk/run. The organizer's schedule lists a 10:00 AM Wave 3; the Strava recording begins about 10:02 AM local and measures 4.03 miles. No indexed individual timing row has yet been recovered, so 41:56 is retained only as the Strava elapsed-time fallback.
